focus: Payments go through a single idempotent queue

memories.title: Payments go through a single idempotent queue

revisions.content:
Retry failed card charges from the API handler.

- Up to 3 attempts with backoff.

Every charge is enqueued with an idempotency key; the worker is the only caller of the payment provider.

- Up to 3 attempts with exponential backoff.
- Refunds use the same queue.

Every charge is enqueued with an **idempotency key** derived from the order ID; the worker is the only caller of the payment provider.

- Up to 3 attempts with exponential backoff (2s, 8s, 30s).
- Refunds and partial captures use the same queue.
- A charge stuck for more than 10 minutes pages the on-call.

**Why:** double charges during the March incident came from two handlers retrying the same request.

**Limits:** the provider keeps idempotency keys for 24 hours, so manual retries after that need a new key.

memories.title: Tax totals drift by one cent on split shipments
memories.content: Rounding each shipment separately and then summing differs from rounding the order total. Round once per order and allocate the remainder to the last line.

memories.title: Apple Pay works end to end in staging
memories.content: Domain verification, merchant session and the token exchange pass in staging. Pending: the production merchant certificate.

memories.title: Error messages say what to do next
memories.content: Write payment errors as an action: "Check the card number" instead of "Invalid input". Never show provider codes to buyers.

memories.title: Address autocomplete only after three characters
memories.content: Fewer requests and no flicker on mobile. The lookup is debounced at 250 ms.

memories.title: Load test plan for Black Friday
memories.content: Target 1,200 orders per minute for 30 minutes with 5% card declines. Run it against the staging replica on Thursday.

memories.title: Safari autofill skips the postal code field
memories.content: The field needs autocomplete="postal-code" and must not sit inside a hidden fieldset when the page loads.

memories.title: The cart is stored offline and synced on launch
memories.content: Local changes win unless a price changed on the server; then the app asks before checkout.

memories.title: Push tokens migrated to the new provider
memories.content: 92% of active devices re-registered. The rest refresh on next launch.

memories.title: Spacing uses a 4 px scale
memories.content: Allowed steps: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48. Anything else needs a comment in the component.
